Ben (Finance): Heads-up — INV-5033 attempted capture and gateway returned decline_code=insufficient_funds. Customer contact on file is unresponsive.
Hannah (Billing): Which payment method was used? card or ACH?
Mira (Support): Webhook: { method: 'card', brand: 'mastercard', last4: '2305', decline_code: 'insufficient_funds' } — tokenization succeeded, 3DS not required.
Sam (AE): Account is NovaThera Labs. They switched finance contacts last month; I don't have a direct mobile. I can escalate to their ops channel but need a recommended next step from billing.
Ben (Finance): We run automated retries at +8h, +24h, +72h by default. I suggest pausing auto-retries for now while AE tries contact, to avoid multiple calls to the same card.
billing-bot: auto_retry INV-5033 attempt=1 scheduled=+8h
Hannah (Billing): I'll mark invoice status = payment_failed and set a hold on auto-capture. Also adding to collections queue with priority medium.
Mira (Support): Created ticket SUP-8947 to track outreach and portal link issues. Noted: customer reported intermittent '502' when submitting new card earlier this month.
Sam (AE): I'll DM the procurement contact and post in their internal slack. If they prefer wire, can we accept it and fast-track reconciliation?
Hannah (Billing): Yes — wire acceptable. Wire instructions: Redwood Inference LLC / FirstCloud Bank / Routing 110000111 / Account 888899990000 / SWIFT FCBUS33 / Reference INV-5033. Ask them to email remittance to billing@redwood.ai.
Ben (Finance): If they request ACH, we do micro-deposits (3 business days). Wire is fastest same-day if they have banking cutoff.
Sam (AE): Noted. I'll offer wire and portal options. Also will ask if they want us to attempt the other card on file (ending 9811).
Hannah (Billing): Don't attempt the second card without explicit permission from customer. If they approve, we can process an authorized retry.
Mira (Support): FYI engineering dug into the 502 portal issue — looks like token service had a GC spike. We deployed a fix last night, but keep an eye.
Sam (AE): I'll mention that and advise them to re-add card via portal: https://billing.redwood.ai/update-payment?inv=INV-5033
billing-bot: account NovaThera grace_period set=72h by Hannah (Billing)
Ben (Finance): Policy check — standard suspension for mid-market is 7 days. Recommend offering 72h grace while AE pursues contact, then suspend if unpaid. Approve?
Hannah (Billing): Approving 72h grace for this account. I'll set the suspension timer accordingly and log note.
Sam (AE): I'll prioritize outreach. If they confirm wire, I'll get SWIFT copy and ping billing for reconciliation.
Mira (Support): Linking SUP-8947 -> INV-5033 and will monitor portal errors.
Ben (Finance): Thanks team. Please update thread after contact or when retry runs.
Hannah (Billing): Thanks — will update ledger once payment posts. :thumbsup:
